data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Aspia was a nymph who represented hope and salvation. Her name derives from the Greek word for hope, aspein, and the Latin word salus, meaning salvation. In Christian tradition, Aspia symbolizes the hope and salvation found through faith in God. The name Aspia carries the meaning “Hope, Salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aspia usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
